criteria.criterion: Under `## External formats`, each line of the form - `<phrase>`: `<path>` is a rule; the path is read before a trailing parenthesis; other lines are ignored
criteria.evidence: internal/brief/extformat.go parseFormatRule accepts only the `phrase`: `path` form, end or ' (' trailer; the test guidelines include a trailing (D...) and two malformed lines

criteria.criterion: When the Behaviour contract contains the phrase (case-insensitive plain substring) and the Binding references section does not contain the path (plain substring), one warning: `external format: the contract mentions "<phrase>" but Binding references do not cite <path> (.vloop/repo-guidelines.md)`
criteria.evidence: extformat.go externalFormatLines lowercases the contract, uses strings.Contains on refs, emits the exact message; TestExternalFormatWarnsWhenNotCited asserts the full text

criteria.criterion: The path cited only in another section (Constraints, What it is) does not satisfy the rule: only Binding references counts (B-4)
criteria.evidence: refs is sectionText of set.BindingRefs only; TestExternalFormatPathInAnotherSectionDoesNotCount

criteria.criterion: With no guidelines file the output is exactly today's; the warning never becomes a problem nor changes the exit code
criteria.evidence: guidelinesSection returns nil on a missing file, so no lines are added; lines are typed Warning; TestExternalFormatNoFileSameOutputAndNeverAProblem compares Failed() and Problems() with and without the file

criteria.criterion: Committed tests (internal/brief) cover the warning, the cited path, the phrase outside the contract, case-insensitivity and no file. Violation: the behaviour shipped with no committed test the checks run
criteria.evidence: internal/brief/extformat_test.go has one test per case; the go check passed (checks.json exit 0)

criteria.criterion: No earlier test is weakened: only the tests the brief's Constraints list change, and only as they state
criteria.evidence: git diff HEAD touches only check.go and pinning.go (a behaviour-preserving extraction of guidelinesSection) and adds new files; no existing test file is modified

notes: The pinning.go refactor shares guidelinesSection between the two rule readers; behaviour is unchanged and the pinning tests still pass. The proposal's note about TestTaskGate* failures inside a driver session is outside this task, and the driver's go check passed.
